product_summary: Website teamonebiotech.com (Mumbai, sales@teamonebiotech.com, +91 8855050575) presents the company as a 'microbial bioremediation' manufacturer with in-house manufacturing and R&D. Real product lines listed on the site: (1) Wastewater/environmental — T1B aeroBio (aerobic biocultures), T1B anaerobio (anaerobic biocultures), T1B F.O.G (fat/oil/grease degrader), T1B bio bloc; (2) Agriculture bio-inputs — T1B MacMi (bio-accelerator with macro & micro nutrients), T1B Spray Biome, T1B Soil Biome; (3) Aquaculture — T1B MacMi Aqua, T1B Acqua F, T1B Acqua S (shrimp/fish probiotics); (4) Natural cleaners — T1B D-Cleaner (drain cleaner), T1B Repel (mosquito/fly repellent), T1B Eco Clean (surface cleaner); (5) Animal probiotics — T1B Gutbiotic (feed probiotic). Core chemistry is live microbial cultures / probiotics / bio-enzymatic blends, not isolated enzyme preparations. Site also claims ISO 9001, ISO 4001 and GMP certification and 'exports to more than 20+ countries' — these are self-declarations only.
role_hint: manufacturer (site claims in-house manufacturing and R&D; no trader signs found in the catalogue — no third-party brands, no 'authorised distributor' language). comment: HS 350790 (enzymes; prepared enzymes n.e.s.) is only partially correct. The declared code covers just one slice of the range — the bio-enzymatic cleaner line (D-Cleaner, Eco Clean) where enzymes are the active principle. The bulk of the catalogue is live microbial cultures and probiotic blends, which belong in 382100 (prepared culture media for microorganism development) rather than 350790; enzymes under 3507 are normally isolated enzyme preparations/concentrates, which the site does not describe. Additional lines are entirely missing from the declaration: agri bio-inputs with macro/micro nutrients (310100 if fertiliser-type), aquaculture and animal-feed probiotics (230990), and disinfectant/biocidal cleaners and insect repellent (380894). Industry label 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is a misclassification: this is a B2B industrial/environmental biotechnology supplier (wastewater treatment, aquaculture, agriculture), with only the natural-cleaner line being consumer-adjacent FMCG. Recommended corrected HS-6 set: 382100 (primary), plus 350790, 310100, 230990, 380894 as applicable per SKU. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground — company is retained with corrected codes. All product data here comes from the company's own website catalogue and is therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено': no customs line, B/L or GST record was checked in this HS-only pass, so actual shipment factuality is not established by this review. No revenue, export volume, CIN or PAN data collected (out of scope for this role; null).
